class.name: MultiplayerTree
class.brief_description: A node that gives its children their own [NetwMultiplayer].

method.name: dispose
method.description: Removes every service and forgets every player.

method.name: raise_embedded_server
method.description: Duplicates this tree as a sibling named [code]Server[/code], with the role [constant NetwMultiplayer.ROLE_DEDICATED_SERVER]. [codeblock] var server := tree.raise_embedded_server() var peer := ENetMultiplayerPeer.new() peer.create_server(21253) server.api.multiplayer_peer = peer [/codeblock]

members.member: An optional script extending [NetwMultiplayer], used for [member api].
The game and build. Peers with a different [member app_id] cannot connect. See [member NetwSessionConfig.app_id].
When running headless, hosts at startup with [member peer_class] and [member transport_settings].
Connects automatically when the game runs, in debug builds only.
The role this tree takes when it hosts.
Simulated latency and packet loss for testing.
The [MultiplayerPeer] class to use, such as [code]&"ENetMultiplayerPeer"[/code].
The settings for creating a [member peer_class] peer, such as [code]{ port = 21253 }[/code] for ENet.
